Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com — A brief jobs-report update says unemployment edged down to 7.2%, prompting a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant offers traditional Swiss cuisine, including cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. The site highlights its cozy alpine-inspired wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. Your introduction and email make it clear whose site it is and how to contact you. Based on the text available, it feels quite minimal; adding a short bio, your interests, and examples of your work would help visitors get to know you better.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a personal touch and a clear starting point. Based on the text available, I'd enjoy seeing more detail—such as stories from favorite hikes, trail recommendations, and photos—to bring your experiences to life.
